meta.name: Love Scout
meta.description:
Yoo Eun-ho, a single dad armed with perfection, becomes the secretary of Kang Ji-yun, the CEO of a popular headhunter company, who doesn't do anything except work.

Ended · First aired 3 Jan 2025 · South Korea · Language: Korean · 70 min
Studio: Studio S, EO Contents Group · Network: SBS

Complete series. On your server: S1 12/12

On your server — Audio: Korean (from file names)

videos.title: Good morning, Ms President
videos.overview: As the CEO of a leading executive search firm, Kang Ji Yun is responsible for scouting and recruiting top talent. However, Yoo Eun Ho consistently hinders her recruitment efforts, posing significant challenges to her objectives.

videos.title: Please judge me only as a secretary
videos.overview: Ji Yun is dissatisfied with her new secretary, Eun Ho. Despite his best efforts to ingratiate himself, Eun Ho is unable to penetrate her icy demeanor.

videos.title: I'm going to find out properly from now on
videos.overview: Eun Ho reflects on his observations at CareerWay. Meanwhile, he gradually adapts to the headhunter lifestyle, and Ji Yun's reserved demeanor begins to soften.

videos.title: I'll give it to you, sir
videos.overview: Upon discovering the past events between Ji Yun and Hye Jin, Eun Ho makes an effort to lift her spirits. Meanwhile, the employees at Peoplez are engaged in a flurry of conflict.

videos.title: How much do you remember?
videos.overview: After the dinner, Ji Yun finds her thoughts drifting to Eun Ho but refuses to entertain the idea. Oblivious to her unrest, Mi Ae arranges a meeting.

videos.title: What kind of person is Yoo Eun-ho?
videos.overview: Ji Yun and Eun Ho spend the night at his house. Ever since then, something is brewing between them. Meanwhile, Su Hyeon's call sends Eun Ho running.

videos.title: I like you
videos.overview: Ji Yun now understands her feelings for Eun Ho. Her eyes are perpetually fixed on her secretary, and others in the office are starting to notice.

videos.title: I got off work
videos.overview: Once Ji Yun and Eun Ho confirm their feelings for each other, they begin a clandestine office romance. Ji Yun attends an event hosted by Chairman U.

videos.title: Now I want to protect you
videos.overview: Eun Ho comforts Ji Yun, and the two grow closer than ever. Ji Yun and Hye Jin compete head-to-head to appoint the CEO of a domestic industry giant.

videos.title: I will never let go of this hand
videos.overview: Ji Yun learns that the child her father had saved back then was Eun Ho. In the light of this shocking truth, their relationship starts to crumble.

videos.title: I am resigning from my position as CEO
videos.overview: Peoplez are under duress from rumors of an investment scam. Ji Yun and Eun Ho tackle the crisis, even living together to avoid the eyes of the press.

videos.title: My perfect couple
videos.overview: When Ji Yun announces her resignation, the office falls into chaos. Confident in her defeat of Ji Yun, Hye Jin moves in to take over the Peoplez firm.
